verdict.rationale: Rootly documents a workflow automation engine, but its runs are tied to trigger events or manual execution; nothing in the evidence shows a time-based or recurring schedule trigger for jobs or workflows. On-call 'schedules' are responder rotations and 'scheduled maintenance' is a status-page concept. Both are adjacent features that do not deliver recurring job scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
